Download the file for your computer, run it, and click **Turn on uploads**. That's it: the app keeps running in the background and shares new WoWCensus data whenever you log out or `/reload`.

| Your computer | Download |
|---|---|
| Windows | `WoWCensus-Companion-VERSION-windows.exe` (or the `.zip` if your browser blocks `.exe` files) |
| Mac | `WoWCensus-Companion-VERSION-macos.dmg` (or the `.zip`) |
| Linux | `WoWCensus-Companion-VERSION-linux-x86_64.AppImage` (or the `.tar.gz`, or the plain binary) |

**Windows:** if you see "Windows protected your PC", click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.

**Mac:** open the `.dmg` and drag **WoWCensus Companion** to Applications. The first time you open it, macOS may say it can't check the app. Go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway**.

**Linux:** make the file executable (`chmod +x`) and run it.
